summary: Population 12 from 9 needs births, and births need free beds and good Community. Build houses ahead of the population, an Open Kitchen for Community (and the optional 25 Stew), and a Farm with Cabbage to keep food up.

build_order.note: 6 Logs, 4 beds. Free beds are what lets couples have children.
10 Sticks; Clay for the kitchen and farm.
6 Sticks + 8 Clay. Stew eaten here gives Community 4 per use; also counts toward 25 Stew (optional).
4 Sticks + 10 Clay; food for the kitchen.
Keep three or four beds free until the population reaches 12.
Optional: Plank Houses hold 5 instead of 4.

pitfalls: Births nearly stop when every bed is taken (the stored no-free-housing multiplier is −0.975).
Kids already on the map count, so only three births are needed; don't over-build industry at the cost of homes.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
